diagnosis: OrderLineCancellationView allows cancelling items within an e-commerce order. The endpoint queries OrderLine.objects.get(pk=line_id) without checking line.order.user == request.user. Any authenticated customer can submit another customer's order line ID to cancel purchases and trigger stock return workflows on orders belonging to other buyers.
exploit_request:
POST /api/orders/lines/77812/cancel/ HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.megamart.com
Authorization: Bearer cust_token_b
Accept: application/json
